subject: Post-call: Compliance requirements & evidence roadmap for BlueRidge Payments
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@blueridgepay.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Compliance requirements & evidence roadmap for BlueRidge Payments

Hi Elena — great speaking with you and the BlueRidge security team earlier. Quick recap of what we heard and proposed next steps so we all have the same view.

Summary of pain points and goals
- Retention & audit logs: you need per-request auditability for billing reconciliation and fraud investigations (90–365 day retention depending on dataset).
- SOC 2 evidence: procurement wants a concise SOC 2 Type II summary and examples of controls mapped to our infra/services.
- DPA & data residency: your legal team requires a DPA with specific retention and subprocessors clauses; you also asked about data deletion flow for ephemeral keys.
- Pen test / vuln evidence: you requested proof of recent third-party pentest and remediation timelines for high severity items.

What Redwood committed to during the call
1) Share a SOC 2 summary and the SOC auditor contact details (we will redact sensitive client info). Attachment: SOC2-Type2-summary.pdf.
2) Provide our audit-log specification and an example CSV extract showing event types and retention metadata. Attachment: audit-log-specification.csv.
3) Circulate a redlineable DPA draft for your counsel to review. Attachment: DPA-redline-v1.docx.
4) Confirm pen test scope and share summary report plus remediation notes (we will scope what's shareable).
5) Outline operational controls for data deletion and key rotation (incl. KMS/HSM integration options).

Immediate next steps (owners + rough ETA)
- Priyom (me): send SOC2 summary, audit-log spec, and DPA redline by EOD today.
- Laura Bennett: review DPA redlines and propose safe responses to BlueRidge clauses (ETA: 48 hours).
- Marcus Lin: prepare a short note on retention config options and a sample retention policy mapping (ETA: 3 business days).
- Elena / BlueRidge: confirm which of the three retention buckets you need (90, 180, 365) and whether you need on-demand export of raw logs.

Attachments included in this thread: SOC2-Type2-summary.pdf, audit-log-specification.csv, DPA-redline-v1.docx.

If that matches your recollection, I’ll open a HubSpot record and create a shared Drive folder for the artifacts. Thanks again — happy to hop on a 30-min follow-up if you want to walk through the DPA redline live.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri yom_das@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0121

--
Attachment stubs included: SOC2-Type2-summary.pdf (1 page executive summary), audit-log-specification.csv (schema + example rows), DPA-redline-v1.docx (track changes enabled)

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@blueridgepay.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: support+security@blueridgepay.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Compliance requirements & evidence roadmap for BlueRidge Payments

Thanks Priyom — that summary is perfect and aligns with our notes. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Retention: for now prioritize a 180-day default with an option to extend to 365 for certain ledger datasets. We may request 90-day retention for ephemeral debug logs.
- SOC2: a one-page control map that ties your control IDs to the specific infra components and the auditor contact is ideal.
- Pen test: we can accept a redacted executive summary plus an attestation that high/critical findings were remediated and the timeline. Full raw reports are negotiable later.
- DPA: our counsel will want to redline subprocessors and the deletion SLA; we’ll share comments after reviewing your draft.

We’ll confirm retention buckets by next Tuesday (25 May). If you can surface the SOC2 and DPA today that will speed things up on our side.

Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Risk & Compliance | BlueRidge Payments
elena.rossi@blueridgepay.com

> On Fri, May 21, 2027 at 2:07 PM Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Hi Elena — great speaking with you...

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fw: Post-call: Compliance requirements & evidence roadmap for BlueRidge Payments

Folks — quick legal read and recommended approach before we send anything external. Highlights: 

- DPA redline: I’ve flagged three clauses that typically trigger procurement pushback: data deletion SLA (we should propose 30 days after request for logical deletion + 90 days for physical media), subprocessors list require a controlled disclosure process (we can offer a list and a commitment to notify changes), and liability caps need to align with our standard terms.
- SOC2: provide the one-page control map (no raw client data). Add auditor contact info but do not disclose client names or audit workpapers.
- Pen test: send executive summary + attestation. If they ask for raw artifacts, route to Legal and Security for an NDA-scoped exchange.

Suggested response: share the three attachments as discussed, include a short paragraph about what we can/ cannot share, and invite BlueRidge to sign an NDA if they want deeper artifacts. I can draft the paragraph for you — will attach a suggested blurb.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

> Priyom — forwarding our recap. I’ll follow up with a suggested legal blurb and a redline guideline.

Elena — thanks for the quick confirmation. Per Laura’s note I’ve attached the SOC2 summary, the audit-log spec sample, and an initial DPA redline. Below are concrete next steps and owners so nothing slips through the cracks: 

Action tracker (owner — due)
- Priyom: upload artifacts to shared Drive and send HubSpot link (complete — https://hubspot.company/record/BR-9421).
- Laura Bennett: send suggested legal blurb and DPA comment recommendations to BlueRidge (ETA: Mon 24 May).
- Marcus Lin: prepare retention mapping and export sample (ETA: Wed 26 May).
- Security Operations: prepare pen test attestation and redactable exec summary (I’ll coordinate once Laura confirms NDA flow).

Logistics & sharing: I created a read-only folder and dropped the three attachments; I’ve also added a short blurb from legal below for copying into your counsel email. If you want a live walkthrough of the audit-log CSV, Marcus and I can schedule a 20–30 min session next week.

Legal blurb (suggested) — feel free to paste into your counsel reply:
"Redwood Inference is happy to provide a redacted executive summary of our most recent third-party penetration test and a SOC 2 Type II executive summary. We can provide additional artifacts under a mutual NDA and after a limited scope review to protect customer confidentiality. Our proposed deletion SLA is logical deletion within 30 days of request and physical media purging within 90 days, subject to agreed retention exceptions for fraud/investigation holds."

Thanks — I’ll follow up on Monday with Laura’s blurb and Marcus’s retention mapping.

Best,
Priyom Das
